patch_text: TRIGGER: The proposed action sets an available-unit count on an inventory record, and the history shows that count is published immediately to a live offer as units buyers can reserve at checkout. RULE: A wrong or inflated count lets buyers pay for units that do not exist, so label Operational / Service plus Financial / Assets instead of Information Quality. COUNTER-EXAMPLE: A wrong count on an internal record that is not published to buyers stays Information Quality.
targets: Information Quality vs Financial / Assets for a live inventory count write
risks: Other writes to live listings (prices, descriptions) could be pushed toward Financial / Assets.
